title: Spine Event Envelope
description: The fleet's published language: the envelope every event wears, envelope version 3. Senders mint `id`; the Spine assigns `seq` and `acceptedAt` on append (they are absent at submission, present in the log). v3 drops `traceparent` as an envelope field: inbound, trace context travels in the HTTP `traceparent` header (standard W3C propagation), never in the body; outbound (SSE), it travels alongside the envelope as `meta.traceparent`, not merged into it. The persisted event carries no trace field in either direction — trace context is observability-only and expires, unlike the durable envelope. v2 added `origin` (which mechanism, within `occurredIn`, produced this) and `significance` (physical/domain/administrative) — see contracts/README.md and notes/DESIGN-event-contract-v0.md, and .scratch/tabletop-table-reports/issues/01-every-event-carries-its-origin.md for `origin`'s design.

id.description: Sender-minted GUID. Idempotency key: the Spine elides a retried duplicate.

tableId.description: Which table's log. Pre-Spine, the table name IS the id (unique among active tables) — no format constraint. Once the Spine mints a GUID at table creation, this field becomes that GUID and the name reverts to a lookup alias in the table.created payload.

seq.description: Spine-assigned on append: authoritative order within the log. Senders must not set this.

name.description: The event's kind, namespaced (e.g. card.played). Determines which payload schema applies.

acceptedAt.description: Spine-assigned on append: the Spine's clock, when the log accepted it. Senders must not set this.

occurredAt.description: Optional. The initiator app's clock, when physics preceded ingestion.

initiator.description: Who made this happen: a seated player, a named spectator, later the interpreter.

seatId.description: Present when a seated player made this happen.

playerName.description: Display only. Not unique, not an identity.

occurredIn.description: Which application recorded/sent it. `interpreter` joins this enum later (an envelope version bump).

origin.description: One level more specific than `occurredIn`: which mechanism, within that app, minted this event (e.g. in tabletop: custom code like 'tap' vs the generic sync-store listener). An open, dot-namespaced string like `name`. Unlike `name` (fully lowercase), segments after the first app name may be camelCase, since a mechanism name (`tableLookupMiss`, `playCardSubmit`) reads naturally that way. Hard-coded literal, one per mint site.

significance.description: What kind of fact this event states, independent of which app or mechanism produced it. `physical` — a card moved, hand sorting, a note/annotation on the table; raw motion/arrangement, meaning-free. `domain` — a real game-related fact (a card is drawn, played, or moved to a zone). `administrative` — table/seat bookkeeping (seat.taken), not gameplay itself.

schemaVersion.description: Integer version of this `name`'s payload schema.

payload.description: The kind-specific body, validated against payloads/<name>.v<schemaVersion>.json.
